facts.fact: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities: parental/guardian income up to Rs 2.50 lakh a year
facts.quote: For Pre-Matric Scheme- The parental/guardian income from all sources should not exceed Rs.2.50 lakh per annum.

facts.fact: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities: parental/guardian income up to Rs 2.50 lakh a year
facts.quote: For Post-Matric Scheme- The The parental/guardian income from all sources should not exceed Rs.2.50 lakh per annum.

facts.fact: Top Class Education scholarship for Students with Disabilities: parental/guardian income up to Rs 8.00 lakh a year
facts.quote: For Top-Class scheme- - The parental/guardian income from all sources should not exceed Rs.8.00 lakh per annum.

facts.fact: All three schemes are on the National Scholarship Portal
facts.quote: The Pre-Matric, Post Matric and Top Class Scholarship Schemes for Disabilities are online schemes which are on-boarded on National Scholarship Portal.

summary: Income limits (Rs 2.50 lakh Pre/Post-Matric, Rs 8.00 lakh Top Class) and NSP onboarding confirmed in the DEPwD FAQ on NSP.
